title: Generate and Email Zoho Creator PDFs in One Click #Shorts
description:
Learn how to automatically generate and email PDF reports from Zoho Creator using a custom button, Deluge script, and Zoho Creator OAuth connection.

1. Add a button to your report
2. Write a script using 'zoho.creator.getRecordByID'
3. Use 'sendmail' task with the PDF attachment

Code (deluge) - Zoho Creator -› Settings -› Custom Actions -› Deluge Editor:
recordData = zoho.creator.getRecordByID("YOUR_ACCOUNT_OWNER", "YOUR_APP_LINK_NAME", "YOUR_REPORT_LINK_NAME", input.recID, "your_oauth_connection");
pdfFile = invokeurl
[
	url : "https://creator.zoho.com/api/v2/YOUR_ACCOUNT_OWNER/YOUR_APP_LINK_NAME/report/YOUR_REPORT_LINK_NAME/" + input.recID + "/pdf"
	type : GET
	connection: "your_oauth_connection"
];
sendmail
[
	from : zoho.adminuserid
	to : "client@example.com"
	subject : "Your Requested PDF Report"
	message : "Hello, please find your attached report."
	files : pdfFile
];
